broad_no_regression_portfolio.optimization: Linear-program feasibility with bisection on worst multiplicative delay R. For every scenario, required crossing time was constrained to min(R * single-lambda-oracle-time, baseline-mixture-time). A dense candidate lambda grid was first solved; a five-component rounded grid was then re-optimized under the same constraints.

design_envelope.decision: first t at which the upper CS endpoint is <= the declared tolerance
design_envelope.oracle: Best single fixed lambda separately for each (tolerance,k), used only as an unattainable per-scenario benchmark.
design_envelope.placement_robustness: For fixed total mismatch count k, front-loading mismatches weakly maximizes every prefix score sum; since each component and the mixture e-value are nonincreasing in score sum, front-loading weakly delays first crossing. Thus early placement is the worst case for first-certification delay among permutations with the same k.

interpretation.component: For binary Y and candidate tolerance m, a lambda component equals the Bernoulli likelihood ratio for a lower mismatch alternative q = m*exp(-lambda)/(1-m+m*exp(-lambda)).
interpretation.small_m_ratio: For rare m, q/m is approximately exp(-lambda), so a lambda portfolio is approximately a portfolio over fractions of the tolerated mismatch burden.

scope_guards: The LP objective is a declared synthetic design envelope, not measured production traffic.
No guarantee is claimed outside binary top-level cluster scores, tolerance grid 0.1%-5%, and 0-50 mismatching clusters before certification.
The no-regression statement is only for the enumerated 306 design scenarios and continuous crossing-time calculation; it is not a universal dominance theorem over arbitrary fractional scores.
The Chugg-Ramdas values are reused from the immediately preceding own-role checkpoint and only for the four already-benchmarked binary fixed-horizon cases.
Do not choose between portfolios after seeing current outcomes without paying a selection penalty or using a predeclared mixture over portfolios.
